observations.body: They say the LORD will bring Israel in if he delights in them, forbid rebellion and fear, and are threatened with stoning before the LORD’s glory appears.

payload.posture: Read Numbers 14:5–10 as refusal, intercession, pardon, and sentence evidence before carrying it into another source.
